name: auto-format
description: Formats every file Claude edits with the right formatter for its language.

disabled.title: Disabled formatters
disabled.description: Comma-separated formatters never to run, e.g. "black, shfmt". Names: biome, prettier, ruff, black, gofmt, rustfmt, shfmt, clang-format, php-cs-fixer.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one formatter run may take before it is stopped.
